mapper.select: WITH form_base_ranked AS ( SELECT module_id, id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY module_id ORDER BY id) as rn FROM app_form_base WHERE form_type = 101 ) SELECT mb.module_name, fbr.id AS form_id, fcsr.* FROM app_form_column_set_require fcsr INNER JOIN app_module_base mb ON mb.id = fcsr.module_id AND mb.ai_flag = 1 LEFT JOIN form_base_ranked fbr ON fbr.module_id = fcsr.module_id AND fbr.rn = 1 WHERE require_url LIKE '%/add/simp'
